documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: Our field services team struggles with missed handoffs. We want workflow coordination and account reporting. Please arrange a discovery meeting to understand our requirements. No budget has been approved.

raw_proposal.assessment: The account is currently in the 'qualified' stage with a score of 80, indicating a strong fit and intent. The customer has expressed interest in workflow coordination and account reporting, and has requested a discovery meeting to establish integration requirements. There is no approved budget, but the customer has provided consent for Cedar Systems to proceed.

claims.quote: Please arrange a discovery meeting to understand our requirements.
A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements.

raw_proposal.draft:
Dear [Customer Name],

Thank you for reaching out to Cedar Systems. We understand that your field services team is experiencing challenges with missed handoffs, and we are here to help. As requested, we would be happy to schedule a discovery meeting to better understand your specific requirements for workflow coordination and account reporting.

Please let us know a convenient time for you, and we will make the necessary arrangements. We look forward to assisting you in streamlining your operations with Cedar Systems.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Cedar Systems Team
[Contact Information]
questions: What is the preferred time for the discovery meeting?
Are there any specific departments or stakeholders that should be included in the meeting?
uncertainties: The customer has not provided an approved budget, which may impact the scope of the discovery meeting.
The exact integration requirements are not yet defined, so the discovery meeting will be crucial in clarifying these.
